verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.attio.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown versions of the doc pages (.md URLs throughout the evidence). The App SDK ships bootstrapped AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files and is described as designed for AI-assisted development, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document is published for agents to consume. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how completely llms.txt covers the docs, and no independent user corroboration of agents working well from these docs.
